channel.title: Ram Guthula
channel.description: Cloud architecture, DevOps, Kubernetes, Terraform, SRE, and platform engineering articles from Ram Guthula.

item.title: SRE Training Series: From Fundamentals to a Production LGTM Stack
item.description: A free 12-part Site Reliability Engineering course covering SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, percentiles, golden signals, PromQL, cardinality, logs, tracing, and building your own LGTM stack.

item.title: What Is SRE? Fundamentals, Error Budgets, and the SRE vs DevOps Question
item.description: A practical introduction to Site Reliability Engineering: what SREs actually do, how error budgets work, how SRE differs from DevOps, and how to measure toil.

item.title: SLI, SLO, and SLA Explained: Choosing Indicators That Reflect Real User Pain
item.description: How to define SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs correctly: the good-events over valid-events pattern, latency and availability SLIs, target selection, and rolling windows.

item.title: Error Budgets and Multi-Window Burn Rate Alerting
item.description: How to calculate and spend error budgets, and how to build multi-window multi-burn-rate alerts in Prometheus that page fast on real outages and stay quiet otherwise.

item.title: p50, p95, p99: Percentiles, Histograms, and Why Averages Lie
item.description: Understand latency percentiles p50, p90, p95, p99 and p99.9, how Prometheus histograms and quantiles work, why you cannot average percentiles, and how to pick bucket boundaries.

item.title: Four Golden Signals, USE, and RED: Utilization, Saturation, and Errors
item.description: A practical guide to the four golden signals, the USE method for resources, and the RED method for services, including utilization vs saturation and run-queue signals.

item.title: Metrics Fundamentals: Counters, Gauges, Histograms, and PromQL That Works
item.description: Prometheus metric types explained: counters, gauges, histograms and summaries, plus rate, increase, irate, aggregation order, recording rules and common PromQL mistakes.

item.title: Cardinality: Designing Labels That Do Not Bankrupt Your Observability Stack
item.description: How metric cardinality works, why user IDs and full URLs destroy Prometheus, how to budget series, and how to use exemplars, recording rules and relabeling to keep it under control.

item.title: Logs at Scale: Structured Logging, Loki, and LogQL
item.description: Structured logging practice plus Loki architecture, label design, LogQL queries, metric queries from logs, retention tiers, and how to correlate logs with metrics and traces.

item.title: Distributed Tracing with OpenTelemetry and Tempo
item.description: A practical OpenTelemetry and Grafana Tempo guide: spans, context propagation, semantic conventions, head vs tail sampling, span metrics, and exemplar-driven correlation.

item.title: Build Your Own LGTM Stack: Loki, Grafana, Tempo, and Mimir
item.description: Hands-on guide to running the Grafana LGTM stack: Loki, Grafana, Tempo, Mimir and Alloy with Docker Compose and Kubernetes, including OTel Collector and storage sizing.

item.title: Dashboards and Alerts That Work at 3 A.M.
item.description: How to design SLO dashboards and alert rules that reduce fatigue: symptom-based alerting, alert routing and grouping, runbook links, and dashboards structured for triage.

item.title: Incident Response, Postmortems, and Scaling the Reliability Practice
item.description: Incident command roles, severity levels, blameless postmortems, on-call health metrics, plus long-term storage, downsampling, and cost control for the observability platform.

item.title: Building an autonomous RCA agent with LangGraph and MCP
item.description: How a LangGraph-orchestrated agent triages Grafana Alertmanager alerts automatically via MCP tool integrations, and safely self-heals in Dev.

item.title: Terraform for Beginners: What to Learn First
item.description: A practical beginner roadmap for learning Terraform, from providers and state to modules, environments, and team workflows.

item.title: Kubernetes on AWS: A Pragmatic Operating Model
item.description: A practical operating model for Kubernetes on AWS, covering standardization, observability, ownership, security, and delivery guardrails.

item.title: Platform Engineering Best Practices That Actually Help
item.description: Practical platform engineering best practices for building golden paths, self-service workflows, trust, and sustainable developer platforms.
